snapshot_scope: Historical checkpoint; original review and record pins retained.
limitations: Identifier-scope review is not complete phenotype validation or whole-record primary review.
Parent, reference, donor, clinical isolate and later experimental subject are separate identities.
No new subject label, allele sequence, strain TaxID, sample, genome or activity measurement inferred.
Source alterations, phenotype labels, assay flags and mechanism classifications remain unchanged.
Frequency of later colonies, baseline susceptibility, plate growth, MIC and MEC remain distinct.
Five publisher primary reviews remain manual; citation replay does not verify uncached Results.
Europe PMC access flags describe its metadata, not whether every publisher page is accessible.
All 41 formerly pending papers have citation metadata; 35 still need identifier review.
Metadata-only export: no protocols, sequences, primers, constructs or enhancement designs.
No NCBI endpoint requests, outreach, terms review, source adoption or GitHub mutations.
